full_metrics.aggregation: Per-event asset MAE first, then equal-weight events. Every method uses the identical complete paired event set within each group.
full_metrics.spearman_aggregation: Mean only over defined per-event Spearman values; defined/undefined coverage is reported separately for every method.
full_metrics.disclosure: n counts events, not assets or paths. Overlapping horizons remain dependent. Systemic labels are posthoc. Descriptive exploration, not causal or calibrated forecasting evidence.

fixed_historical_30_decomposition.denominator: identical complete paired events; failures retained outside arithmetic
fixed_historical_30_decomposition.replication_claim: observational comparison only; no preselected significance or closeness threshold
